story.titleZh: 车手对2030年F1超车辅助方案意见分歧
story.summaryZh: 拉斯维加斯大奖赛出现352次超车，维斯塔潘认为其中尾流效应这一要素应延续到2030年新车上，但车手们对超车辅助机制的具体运作方式看法不一。
story.originalTitle: Drivers divided on how F1's 2030 overtaking aid should work
story.summaryEn: The Las Vegas Grand Prix produced 352 passes, and Max Verstappen believes the slipstream effect behind them should be carried over to the 2030 cars, though drivers are divided on how an overtaking aid should work.
detailZh: 拉斯维加斯大奖赛的场面或许没能平息外界对F1现行规则中人为元素的批评，但其中有一个要素，就连立场坚定的批评者马克斯·维斯塔潘也认为应延续到2030年的新车上。
尽管维斯塔潘在拉斯维加斯执行得恰到好处，帮助他拿下一场令人难忘的胜利，但他对比赛的进程并不满意，并把这场比赛比作《马力欧卡丁车》。
然而，拉斯维加斯有一个潜在因素对其352次超车贡献很大，维斯塔潘建议在F1开始整合2030年愿景时对此加以考虑。
那就是拉斯维加斯的场面并不只关乎电池电量差——正是电池电量差引发了我们在澳大利亚和中国等站看到的赛季初拉锯战。
拉斯维加斯比赛的动态是由尾流如此强大所造就的：领先者无法拉开差距，后方车群压缩成一列火车。
即使某辆赛车掉出了那个神奇的一秒窗口、会失去超车模式，它们只需沿着拉斯维加斯大道借助超强牵引力就能重新获得那个窗口甚至更多。
这还得益于赛车在长直道末端耗尽电池能量——因此功率与阻力之比发生了剧烈变化。
小红牛车手阿尔维德·林德布拉德表示：“这对比赛其实很有利。你半圈只有500马力，却带着F1的阻力。那就像把F3引擎装进F1赛车。你想找到尽可能大的尾流，因为阻力超大，但你却没有动力。”
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利补充道：“从第二名到垫底，这场比赛是确定的，因为你必须在能量管理方式、超车方式、驾驶方式以及保持在那段差距内以受益于尾流的方式上都很聪明。”
“对于领跑者来说，无论你的速度多快、驾驶得多好，马克斯[维斯塔潘]或乔治[拉塞尔]都会因为破风并处于车阵前端而损失大量时间，所以根本没有办法[拉开差距]。”
正是这种超强尾流现象，维斯塔潘认为应当成为2030年新一代赛车概念的核心——因为这将有助于改善比赛并减少对DRS等装置的依赖。
当被The Race问及他对2030年起什么能造就最纯粹的赛车比赛的愿景时，维斯塔潘表示，组合式赛车概念和更简单的引擎将是完美的。
维斯塔潘说：“从我们过去开发的所有东西来看，如果你看从上世纪80年代到2010年，当然你有统治性的赛车、统治性的车队。”
“它们有时快一秒甚至两秒多。现在我不认为你还会看到那种情况。但你仍然可以设计出一种规则，让赛车在直道上阻力超大，这样你就不需要那么依赖DRS。”
“对我来说，一键超车系统没问题。但是的，它需要是一台容易得多的引擎。比如每次我做表演圈，开小红牛7之类的，开起来就是很舒服，因为油门响应，一切都轻松。”
“它起步顺畅，赛车不抖，没有迟滞之类的。开起来比我们现在的车舒服多了。”
“所以只要我们能回到接近那种状态的引擎——我知道它需要某种混合动力元素，可能甚至需要涡轮增压器，因为否则在某些赛道上你甚至可能不被允许驾驶，因为太吵了，这没问题。”
“只要它不凌驾于自然的驾驶元素之上，而目前当然正在发生这种情况。”
2026年赛车常常反直觉的驾驶要求，持续让维修区里的许多人感到恼火，但人们对超车性质的变化同样不屑。
2030年需要做出的重大决定之一，是使用哪种类型的额外超车辅助手段来配合新的涡轮V8引擎。
目前摆在桌面上的选项包括：保留现有的超车模式概念、采用类似印地赛车那样的按键加速系统，或者回归 DRS。
虽然 DRS 有时也因人为痕迹过重而受到批评，但阿斯顿·马丁车队的兰斯·斯特罗尔认为，相比现在的比赛方式，DRS 带来的是一种更自然的竞速形态。
“我认为 DRS 时代的比赛比现在更好，”他说。“它们完美吗？不完美。在理想世界里，你希望能毫无干扰地跟住一辆车，然后不必依赖 DRS 或任何类似的东西。”
斯特罗尔承认 DRS 有其缺陷，有时作用过强，有时又常常不够好用，但他觉得它的优点之一是能够创造超车机会。
他说：“在那些DRS设计得当、直道长度合理并且有良好超车区域的地方，我们总能看到非常精彩的DRS比赛。但有些赛道你根本没法超车。所以那样也不行。我觉得这很棘手。”
“要让所有条件都完美配合是很棘手的。但我们现在的做法绝对不是前进的方向，因为你并不是在刹车区完成超车。你是在直道中途超车，那并不激动人心。”
“有了DRS，情况并不完美，远非如此。但你希望看到的是赛车足够接近，让你能在进入弯道时发起攻击，而不是仅仅因为你的速度快了50公里/小时就在直道上超过去。”
这种超车的艺术——即超车是车手必须做出的动作，而不是不费力就发生的事情——是卡洛斯·塞恩斯认为至关重要的东西。
他说：“我认为速度差应该更多出现在直道起点、也就是你试图保持尾流的时候，而不是在直道末端、超车和速度都太高的时候。”
“我认为超车模式、一键加速、DRS，不管你怎么称呼它，它的动力应该出现在出弯时。也就是说，你获得额外的动力提升，比如说，用来弥补你在弯道中损失的时间，但这一提升不应该随后帮助你完成超车。”
“我认为这一提升应该帮助你设法重新进入非常接近的尾流，然后利用气流和剩余的刹车点来完成你自己的超越动作。”
“这就是我心目中一键加速、动能回收系统、能量释放，不管你怎么称呼它，应该起作用的方式。”
“我觉得那次奇怪的超车也和DRS有关，当你在直道上速度差达到30公里/小时，你冲过来得太快，即使你处在前面，你也不敢防守、不敢切线挡住他，因为速度差太大了。”
detailEn: The Las Vegas Grand Prix spectacle might not have silenced critics over the artificial elements of Formula 1’s current rules, but there was one element to it that even staunch critic Max Verstappen thinks should be carried forward to the new 2030 cars.
Despite his perfectly judged execution in Las Vegas that helped pull off a memorable triumph, Verstappen was not impressed with how things played out in a race he likened to Mario Kart.

Yet there was one underlying aspect to Las Vegas that contributed a lot to its 352 passes, and is something that Verstappen suggests should be pondered as F1 begins pulling together its vision for 2030.
It is that the Las Vegas show was not just about battery offsets, which were the trigger for the early season yo-yo battles that we saw in Australia and China for example.
The dynamics of the Las Vegas race, with the leader unable to break away and a pack of cars compressed in a train behind, were set up by the slipstream being so powerful.
Even if a car fell outside the magic one-second window where they would lose overtake mode, they would regain that and more long the Las Vegas Strip simply through a super powerful tow.
This had been helped by cars running out of battery energy at the end of the long straight - so the power to drag ratio shifted dramatically.

Racing Bulls driver Arvid Lindblad said: "It actually worked well for racing. You did half the lap with 500 horsepower, but with the drag of an F1. So then it's like putting an F3 engine in an F1 car. You want as big a tow as you can find because it's super draggy, but you have no power."

Alpine's Pierre Gasly added: "From P2 to last, it was a certain race in terms of you had to be smart in the way you manage your energy, in the way you make the moves, in the way that you drive and stay in that gap to benefit from the tow.

"For the leader, regardless of your speed and how well you drove, Max [Verstappen] or George [Russell] were losing so much time from punching in the air and being at the front end of that pack that there was just no way [to pull clear]."

It was this super powerful tow phenomenon that Verstappen thinks should be central to the concept of the new generation cars in 2030 – as it would help improve the racing and reduce the need for things like DRS.
Asked by The Race about his vision of what would make the purest car for racing from 2030, Verstappen said a combination car concept and simpler engines would be perfect.
"With all the things that we have developed in the past, if you see from like the 1980s to 2010, of course you had dominant cars, dominant teams," Verstappen said.

"They were sometimes over a second or two seconds a lot faster. Now I don't think you will have that anymore. But you can still come up with a formula where maybe a car is just super draggy in a straight line, so you don't need to rely so much on DRS.

"A push-to-pass system for me is fine. But yeah, it needs to be a much easier engine. Like every time I do a show run, for example in an RB7 or whatever, it's just so nice to drive because the throttle response, like everything, is just easy.
"It drives off nice, the car is not shaking about, it has no lag, stuff like that. It's just a lot nicer to drive than what we have currently.

"So as long as we can get back to an engine close to that - I know it needs to be some kind of hybrid element, probably even a turbocharger because otherwise you're probably not even allowed to drive at some tracks anymore because it's too loud, which is fine.
"As long as it's not overruling the natural driving element, which of course at the moment it's happening."
The often counterintuitive driving requirements of the 2026 cars are something that continues to annoy many in the pitlane, but there is equal disdain about how the nature of overtaking has changed.
One of the big decisions that needs to be made for 2030 is what type of extra overtaking aid will be used to accompany the new turbo V8s.
Options on the table include keeping the current overtake mode concept, a push-to-pass system like IndyCar has, or going back to DRS.
While DRS also had its critics at times for being artificial, Aston Martin’s Lance Stroll is one who thinks it delivered a more natural form of racing than what happens right now.

"I think the DRS races are better than we have now," he said. "Were they perfect? No, in an ideal world, you'd want to kind of be able to follow a car with absolutely no disturbance and then not have to rely on DRS or anything like that."

Stroll acknowledges that DRS had its flaws in terms of being too powerful at times, or often not working well enough, but he felt that one of its strengths was how it opened up overtaking opportunities.

"Where the DRS was thought out well, and where the straights were reasonable and then there's a good overtaking zone, we always saw really good races with DRS," he said. "But there's some tracks you just can't overtake at all. So that doesn't work either. I think it's tricky.

"It's tricky to get all the stars aligned. But what we have now is definitely not the way forward because you're not overtaking into a braking zone. You're overtaking halfway down the straight and that's not exciting.

"With DRS, it wasn't perfect, far from it. But you want to just see the car getting close enough where you can make a move going into the corner and not just overtake down the straight because you are 50km/h quicker."
This art of the overtake – about it being a move a driver has to make rather than something that happens without effort – is something Carlos Sainz thinks is essential.

"I think the delta on speed should come more at the beginning of the straight when you are trying to keep the slipstream rather than at the end of the straight when the overtaking and the speed is too high," he said.

"I think the power of the overtake mode, push to pass, DRS, whatever you want to call it, should happen exiting the corner. That you have an extra power boost, let's say, to catch up what you're losing in the corner, but the boost shouldn't then help you to finish the overtake.
"I think the boost should help you manage to get back into the very close slipstream and then use the draft and the rest of the braking point to make your own move.
"That is my ideal way of how a push to pass, KERS, deployment, call it whatever you want, should work.

"I think the weird overtaking that happened also a bit with DRS is when you get delta top speeds of 30km/h and you arrive so quick that even when you're in front, you're too scared to defend and cut him off because the delta speed [speed difference] is so high."
keyPointsZh: 维斯塔潘虽在拉斯维加斯夺冠，但称这场比赛像《马力欧卡丁车》，对比赛过程并不满意。
拉斯维加斯的超车并非只靠电池电量差，长直道末端电量耗尽使功率与阻力之比发生明显变化，超强尾流也起了很大作用。
小红牛车手阿尔维德·林德布拉德表示这种特性对比赛有利，称半圈只有500马力却带着F1的阻力在跑。
keyPointsEn: Although Verstappen won in Las Vegas, he likened the race to Mario Kart and was not impressed with how it played out.

Las Vegas overtaking was not only about battery offsets: cars running out of battery energy at the end of the long straight shifted the power-to-drag ratio dramatically, and the powerful tow also played a big role.
Racing Bulls driver Arvid Lindblad said it worked well for racing, describing half a lap with 500 horsepower but with F1 drag.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
